arc: conversation: friends' problem ×3 messages → ask the AI in-thread → AI answer (feature) → agreement + thanks reaction → fade

scenes.title: Group chat argument with typing dots and spring scroll
scenes.summary: Square, black, iMessage-style group thread. Typing dots pulse in a grey bubble, then Benji Taylor's message lands: "what time do we need to leave for SFO? flight boards at 7". Alex Abraham types and replies "idk like 6?", then Benji pushes back "no 5, security will be a mess". Each new item shoves the list up on a slightly underdamped spring, older lines fade into a black gradient at the top, with receive sounds on each message.
scenes.build: Only a slice: the scene calls buildChat(ctx) from components/chat.ts and drives it with toSourceFrame(frame, fps, 0). chat.ts holds the whole SCRIPT (who, lines, landing frame, push), draws each bubble/label to an OffscreenCanvas CanvasTexture on an orthographic pixel-space plane, and positions every item with a sum of damped-spring step responses (SCROLL_SPRING) per scroll event.
scenes.reuse: Borrow chat.ts for any messaging-thread story (support chat, group chat, AI chat): rewrite SCRIPT and resize bubble width/height per message, swap avatars and the palette in components/brand.ts. Copying this scene file alone gives nothing; take components/chat.ts and brand.ts.

scenes.title: Asking the AI assistant in-thread, typing, then the answer
scenes.summary: The user's blue sent bubble "grok, what time should we leave" fades in on the right. A white four-point spark mark appears with a typing indicator for about a second, then the assistant's four-line answer lands under the label "Grok": "5:20. 101 is only about 25 min that early, but Terminal 2 security has been 15 to 20 min this week. You'd be at the gate by 6:30 ✈️". The thread springs up to make room.
scenes.build: Slice of the continuous take: buildChat(ctx) from components/chat.ts at OFFSET 216. The assistant's avatar is a canvas-drawn four-point spark (drawGlyph) instead of a photo; sent bubbles fade in place over ~16 frames, incoming ones crossfade over the typing bubble and settle up 8px.
scenes.reuse: The core 'AI answers in the chat' beat for any assistant or bot feature announcement; change the question, the answer lines (and bubble height), and the assistant mark. Copy components/chat.ts, not this file. Don't reuse the Grok name as your product unless it is.

scenes.title: Agreement, thanks bubble, thumbs-up reaction, fade to black
scenes.summary: Alex types and replies "ok 520", the user sends "thanks grok", and a 👍 reaction pill pops out from under that bubble with a small overshoot. The thread holds, then the whole frame fades to black.
scenes.build: Slice of the continuous take: buildChat(ctx) at OFFSET 410. The reaction is a canvas-drawn pill parented to the thanks bubble's group, scaled 0.4 → 1.06 → 1; the outro is a black plane whose opacity interpolates over OUTRO [666, 680].
scenes.reuse: Only useful together with the rest of components/chat.ts; the reaction-pop and outro fade are the bits worth noting. Same rewrite path as the other scenes.
